info.title: Traigent Deploy Publish-result and Pinned Config Routes
info.description: Agent-configuration-head deploy target of TVL Reactive Contracts (TRAIG-101 plan 8): publish-result lookup and finalize. The deploy publication itself is POST .../deploy-publications (best_config_agent_head_config_endpoints.json), a branch separate from POST /api/v1/best-configs because its precondition is the APPROVAL-TIME generation, whereas best_config_endpoints.json requires the generation captured at optimization start and forbids refreshing it.

get.summary: Look up the durable publish-result record of a deploy
get.description: Lookup by deploy idempotency key. An absent lookup (404 reference_not_found) alone never justifies a terminal outcome. Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused). Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the closed 404 {"success":false,"error":"reference_not_found","error_code":"reference_not_found","message":"Reference not found."} before authentication and body processing, indistinguishable from a missing or inaccessible reference. Every error body is the closed envelope ../optimization/tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal except 429.

401.description: unauthenticated. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

403.description: forbidden, fact_source_not_permitted. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

404.description: reference_not_found. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: rate_limited. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait; the only rate-limit detail on the wire.

500.description: internal_error. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

503.description: service_unavailable. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

post.summary: Publish the approved configuration version to the environment's agent head
post.description: Publishes best_config_id at version to the agent head of the environment bound to the approval, under the deploy idempotency key in the path; the stored result is readable through the GET beside it. Body is DeployPublishRequest. Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused). Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the closed 404 {"success":false,"error":"reference_not_found","error_code":"reference_not_found","message":"Reference not found."} before authentication and body processing, indistinguishable from a missing or inaccessible reference. post.summary: Finalize an ambiguous deploy publish under the head lock
post.description: Locks the agent head only (publisher lock order is best-config row then head; finalization never takes the best-config row afterward) WITHOUT satisfying an expected-generation precondition, then returns the stored success or commits a cancellation tombstone; a tombstoned publication cannot commit (publish answers 409 publication_cancelled). Unavailable or timed-out finalization means HOLD. Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only (X-Tenant-Id, query strings and unknown body fields are never consulted or are refused).
